UK SSP CALCULATOR 2026/27 · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

How much Statutory Sick Pay do you owe for this absence?

Enter the employee's average weekly earnings, their qualifying days and the sickness dates. You get the weekly and daily rate, waiting days, days paid, the 28-week limit and the total SSP due, with the 6 April 2026 rule change applied day by day.

Written from the published rules without a live lookup. Rates and rules change; GOV.UK and HMRC decide. Not legal, payroll or employment advice.

What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: the 4-day period of incapacity test, qualifying days, the rate as the lower of the flat rate and 80% of average weekly earnings from 6 April 2026, the older waiting-day and lower-earnings-limit rules before that date, and the 28-week limit for one spell.
    • 
      
  • Gives: weekly and daily rate, waiting days, days paid and the total SSP due, as a text file you can keep with the payroll record.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: how average weekly earnings are calculated from the 8-week reference period, whether the employee is an employee for SSP, notice and evidence rules, company sick pay schemes, linked spells beyond the waiting-day field, and entitlement after 28 weeks. Your payroll provider or HMRC decides these.
    • 
    

  


  

    
Common questions

    
How much is Statutory Sick Pay in 2026/27?

    
The flat weekly rate is £123.25 from 6 April 2026, or 80% of the employee's average weekly earnings if that is lower. Check GOV.UK for the current figure.

    
Are there still waiting days?

    
Not for sickness from 6 April 2026: SSP is payable from the first qualifying day. Before that date the first three qualifying days of a period of incapacity were unpaid.

    
Does the employee need to earn the lower earnings limit?

    
Not from 6 April 2026. Before that date, average weekly earnings had to be at least £125.

    
How long does SSP last?

    
Up to 28 weeks per entitlement. Linked spells within 8 weeks of each other add together.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent.
